ella: Noticing widespread client stalls after 0.12.4 release when running high fan-out async workloads (~150-800 concurrent tasks). Tasks just queue, user-visible latency spikes.
ravi: Any stack traces? Could be httpx limit changes.
ella: No exceptions. Simple repro attached below. Happens on our sample apps that create a new AsyncClient per request.
```
# tiny repro
import asyncio
from redwood import AsyncClient

async def hit(i):
    async with AsyncClient() as c:
        await c.generate('ping')

async def main():
    await asyncio.gather(*[hit(i) for i in range(300)])

asyncio.run(main())
```

kai: I ran that locally, same behavior. Downgrading to 0.12.3 fixes it. Looks like PR that introduced a global semaphore defaulting to 100 is the culprit (limits concurrency behind one lock).
docs-bot: Recommends using a shared AsyncClient rather than per-request instantiation.
ravi: Right — the best pratice is reuse a single client + tune httpx.Limits. But onboarding samples create per-request clients which is an easy UX trap.
ella: Temporary fixes: set AsyncClient(max_concurrency=600) or reuse one client. Both help. But we should change the SDK default; 100 is surprising.
kai: Propose change: default max_concurrency to None (fall back to httpx/httpcore defaults) and document recommended patterns in quickstart. Also add env override RWD_PYSDK_MAX_CONCURRENCY for org-wide caps.
ravi: Add test that runs asyncio.gather(400) in CI to prevent regressions. Also include a small benchmark in perf suite.
ops: Filing incident INC-2026 for affected customer demo yesterday.
ella: I'll open PR to change default and add tests/docs. Linking: https://git.internal/redwood/sdk/pull/900
ravi: Reviewed, small nits. Please call out migration guidance in CHANGELOG and sample updates.
kai: I'll update sample-apps repo to use single shared client and show example with httpx Limits.
docs-bot: deploy:staging kicked off for 0.12.5-rc1 by ravi
ella: Thanks team — once rc is up I'll run loadbench and confirm tail latency is gone.
ops: Also consider adding a short note in the troubleshooting guide about per-request clients causing connection/latency issues.
ravi: Agreed. Decided plan: change default -> None, add env var, CI test, docs + sample updates. Target patch 0.12.5.
ella: :thumbsup:
